get.description:
Retrieves check-in information for members. The start and end parameters are optional. 
If only one parameter is passed, the other will be calculated to 24 hours away, and a warning will be issued in the response.
If the optional mid parameter is passed, the start date will default to January 1 of the current year 
and the end date will default to the current date. 
The start and end parameters can be used to specify a different range. 
If an invalid date range is given, the default dates will be used, and a warning will be issued.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start of the check-in range.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End of the check-in range.

parameters.name: memberId
parameters.description: Get check-ins for a specific member.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Get a count of check-ins instead of the check-ins themselves.

parameters.name: successOnly
parameters.description: Exclude reverted check-ins.

evaluated_end.description: End date of the evaluation period, in YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss format.

checkins.description: List of check-ins for the member.

CheckedInDateTime.description: Date and time when the member checked in, in YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss format.

MemberID.description: ID of the member who checked in.

Reverted.description: Indicates whether the check-in was reverted (1) or not (0).

UnitID.description: ID of the unit associated with the check-in.

BranchID.description: ID of the branch where the check-in occurred.

HomeBranchID.description: ID of the member's home branch.
